workflow.name: 61 - LiteLLM primary remote planner cycle - GPT-Web authored - INACTIVE

reason: Attempt 12 captured sanitized body_shape proving that n8n HTTP Request fullResponse returns an envelope with top-level keys data, headers, statusCode, statusMessage. The current Capture HTTP body + status node serializes the whole envelope because it checks resp.body and otherwise uses resp. This causes the canonical Responses/SSE normalizer to receive the n8n wrapper instead of the LiteLLM payload. The bounded fix unwraps resp.data only when the exact fullResponse-wrapper structure is present, before response_b64, SSE census and body-shape inspection are produced.
preserve: all 13 nodes and all node ids/names/types/typeVersions/positions
HTTP Request - LiteLLM primary one-shot parameters, timeout, fullResponse and responseFormat=text
canonical prepare and finalize commands and arguments
response_b64 remains the internal handoff into canonical finalize
WF40, WF60/OpenClaw, credentials, network, Tailscale and TeamViewer state
forbidden: normalizer semantic changes in this pass
generic unwrapping of arbitrary objects that merely contain a data field
acceptance_apply: the new branch recognizes the exact captured n8n fullResponse wrapper by presence of data+headers+statusCode+statusMessage
for that wrapper only, the value serialized to response_b64 and inspected by sse_census/body_shape is resp.data
legacy resp.body behavior remains first priority
non-wrapper objects still fall back to resp unchanged
all existing capture and canonical finalize plumbing remains unchanged

required_cases: captured fullResponse-like object with data string -> selected body equals data
captured fullResponse-like object with data object -> selected body equals serialized data object
object with body field -> body keeps precedence
object with data but missing one or more wrapper keys -> no unwrap
plain canonical response object -> no unwrap
sse_census/body_shape operate on selected inner body, not wrapper
